text:
Predicates:
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10List(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
SoldMoreThan(x, y) ::: x sold more than y copies.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
Sell(x, y) ::: x sold y copies.

Premises:
Created(legendOfZelda, nintendo) ::: The Legend of Zelda was created by Nintendo.
∀x (Top10List(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(x, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (Sell(x, y) ∧ y > 1,000,000 → Top10List(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
Sell(legendOfZelda, moreThanOneMillion) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.

Conclusion:
¬Top10List(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
